notes.title: Update #10 - WMR support
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

WMR official support is here :). We know some of you has been waiting for it for a long time. You can now play the Space Battle VR with your Windows Mixed Reality headset.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33974627/71927172ae0d9de97d4d3621f7edf873fd76c989.png[/img]

I would also like to remind you that we have special options in the game to deal with the sitting position and the joystick position. So when you already tried restarting SteamVR, restarting your PC, installing new drivers, SteamVR updates, and you also put the SteamVR window on top, and you still don't feel like your position in game is accurate please try to calibrate it in the game in two steps:

1. Re-center the view with just one button - you can do it in the main menu or in the gameplay scene. Click the button on your right controller (it depends on the headset, it can be "x", "y", "a", or "menu button"). You will see a little popup window and there will be the re-center button.

2. If above is not enough you can manually change the sitting position and the joystick position in the same popup window. It looks like this:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33974627/76fb53cbe1b978c82234af60e09468f7e78eedd0.png[/img]

More info here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/982700/announcements/detail/1708454708459977492


Best wishes and happy playing!

notes.title: Update #9 - Knuckles/Index controllers
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

Just a nice little patch this time. We added a proper key bindings for knuckles/index controllers. They are tested and ready to use in Space Battle VR!

Next thing on the roadmap: WMR support.


Best wishes and happy playing!

notes.title: Update #8 - no bouncing off of planets anymore ;)
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

We have another small update with an important fix and the new video from the game, let's take a look.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GlbEym2jVHM

Right now, you can download a small update through your Steam client in which we are fixing something that many players finds annoying - bouncing off of the planet. It is no longer a case. Now, your ship will properly blow up on a collision ;).


Best wishes and happy playing!


PS. Lastly, a small fraction of players may experience a weird sitting position bug. It is not our fault and there is a simple solution for this - in such situation please update and recalibrate your steamVR/Oculus.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/982700/Space_Battle_VR

notes.title: Update #2 - sitting position in cockpit
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

We continue our small updates series. I know many of you will like this one because we've implemented a commonly desired features.


[h1]Adjustable sitting position in the cockpit[/h1]

While in the cockpit click a hand-menu button on your right controller (the exact button depends on the headset you use but it should be "x", "y", "a", or "menu button"). Then click the "options" button. You will see arrows that let you change a sitting position according to your needs. You can go up-down-left-right and also forward-backward.

[h1]Adjustable joysticks placement[/h1]

Just do the same as for adjusting the sitting position. You will see similar arrows on the left side of the menu. Click on them to adjust joysticks placement. 


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/982700/Space_Battle_VR/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33974627/76fb53cbe1b978c82234af60e09468f7e78eedd0.png[/img][/url]


This two options combined together let everyone experience the game more comfortable than before. And as you know, we are focusing on delivering the best VR experience we can. It's just our way :)


[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*] added adjustable sitting position in a cockpit
[*] added adjustable joysticks placement in a cockpit
[*] added "easy" mode and slightly balanced normal and master mode
[/list]

Best wishes and happy playing!

PS. We are still testing all difficulty levels and we are preparing them for one of the future updates in which we will add attack waves of enemies to some missions. Please don't panic if "easy" is too easy or so at the moment :D

notes.title: Big update and huuge sale -40%
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

Today is the dream come true for anyone interested in Space Battle VR. We give you a big update today with new cooler and cleaner base UI, new sounds, and possibility to complete the game in the MASTER mode.
But there is more! At 10:00AM PST the huge -40% sale begins. It is the perfect moment to buy Space Battle VR! :)


https://store.steampowered.com/app/982700/Space_Battle_VR/

[h1]What's there in this update?[/h1]

There are two main big points in this update along with small fixes:

1) Redesigned and soo much cooler UI in the base station.
2) The Master mode - more fun for experienced players.


[h1]Great first impression[/h1]

We believe it matters what you see when you jump into the game. And now it will be really cool! More intuitive, more beautiful, more interactive. Just take a look:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/982700/Space_Battle_VR/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33974627/1feae26b687723498dd73c8662a760dc60457713.png[/img][/url]


[h1]The Master mode[/h1]

Try to beat the game as a master! The dark lord will command his troops to fight at full power. This means that every mission is a true challenge. Experienced players will surely appreciate that you can choose to fight opponents that are as good as you.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/982700/Space_Battle_VR/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33974627/638e2a2a601c9e7169f3e8f5c24cc6e4400a5ea6.png[/img][/url]


[h1]Additional changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]haptic feedback[/b] on receiving damage - you will feel that opponents hit you
[*] bugfix: some of the mothership parts don't have colliders on them
[*] bugfix: light artefacts in the mission #6
[/list]

Don't lose your chance to get the Space Battle VR at the best price yet! And stay tuned for more updates in the near future.

Best wishes and happy playing!

notes.title: Last update before Christmas
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

Today's small update is a part 2 of our Christmas gift. We hear you and we've implemented a bunch of your requests during this week. The last thing that is already available to you since now is...

[list]
[*] swap dominant hand (aka left-handed cockpit support)
[/list] 

You can go to settings and change the placement of virtual joysticks in a cockpit to be more comfortable for left-handed people.
Or another way to do it: just click on "menu button" on your controller while in cockpit. You will see a small menu with an option to swap joysticks.


Merry Christmas and happy playing!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/982700/Space_Battle_VR/

notes.title: Thanks for your feedback! Changes and fixes in the new update
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

We really couldn't appreciate your feedback more. We love how you share your thoughts with us. Thanks to the feedback we can improve the Space Battle VR. 

[b]New update is out![/b]

List of changes:
[list]
[*] you can adjust the sensitivity of the controllers in the main menu,
[*] grabbing the stick is a little bit easier (more forgiving),
[*] alternative steering available as an option:
   a) move left/right instead of roll,
   b) inverted up/down if you want
[*] re-calibration of center of view is now stored and used for all missions unless you change it again manually by pressing SPACE or F5 on keyboard or by pressing the biggest button on your left VR controller,
[*] better controllers detection in your home environment (no matter if you are sitting in front of your computer or slightly sideways)
[/list]


This week we will be constantly updating the game according to your needs so everybody will be happy with it at Christmas time :)

Best wishes and happy playing!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/982700/Space_Battle_VR/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33974627/b4cd289b9e5e62b5d681072171c9db0940f24515.png[/img][/url]
